submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.0242% at Sb=0.31. Sampling across the line showed EQE is higher at low Sb (0.17–0.31) than at high Sb (0.51 and 0.68). A quadratic fit put the peak near Sb≈0.27, but index 3 measured lower (0.017%), so the response is noisy or not smooth. The best measured composition is index 4.
